newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept copper exports fall 11.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept copper exports fall 11.7 pct.

text.p: China's exports of uncast and raw copper slumped 11.7 percent to 76,814 tonnes in the first nine months, the China Securities said on Saturday.
Exports of uncast and raw copper reached 7,625 tonnes in September alone, the newspaper quoted customs figures as showing. It gave no comparison for the monthly figure.
Exports of uncast copper, including alloys, slumped three percent to 27,788 tonnes in the first nine months.
Exports of uncast copper, including alloys, reached 2,172 tonnes in September.
China's imports of uncast and raw copper rose 27.4 percent to 467,026 tonnes in the first nine months, the figures showed.
Imports of uncast and raw copper reached 65,958 tonnes in September.
Imports of uncast copper, including alloys, were up 52.4 percent to 177,519 tonnes in the first nine months.
Imports of uncast copper, including alloys, were 28,924 tonnes in September alone.
